header.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a single very wide panoramic header photograph, 3:1 aspect ratio, for the literary story 'Chauffé, éclairé / No fixed arrangement.' No words in the image. An ordinary Montreal rented-room threshold seen from low standing height, slightly careless personal snapshot. At left a squat old cast-iron radiator beneath a badly painted window, condensation at the bottom of the glass; in the middle a chipped partly open interior door with its strike plate hanging a little loose, an unremarkable butter knife resting on the narrow ledge beside it; through the gap at right a worn linoleum corridor, someone's soft overfilled overnight bag and a single ceiling light switched on though it is still daylight. A cheap extension lead emerges from the room and disappears out of frame. Domestic, temporarily occupied, understated and faintly absurd: everything is usable and slightly inconvenient. Restrained natural colour, cold window light and ordinary warm incandescent hallway light, crisp tactile paint and metal, a little digital grain. Uneventful, unposed, not art-directed, not a horror scene or picturesque poverty. No people, no body parts, no logos, no words, no watermark, no collage, no dramatic cinematic grading, no symbol-laden props. Use the full panoramic frame, not letterbox bars.
